settings.title: What is the MiaDonna Design Studio?
settings.content: The Design Studio is an interactive space where you can explore, customize, and create fine jewelry that reflects your personal style. You’ll be able to choose your preferred diamond shape, quality, and carat weight, along with metal and setting details, so your piece aligns beautifully with both your vision and your budget.

settings.title: Do I need design experience to use the Design Studio?
settings.content: No experience is needed. The Studio is intuitive and easy to navigate, allowing you to see your piece come to life in full 3D as you design it.

settings.title: What types of jewelry can I design?
settings.content:
You can customize many of our most-loved styles,
including:
  • • Engagement Rings
  • • Three Stone Rings
  • • Eternity Bands
Each category offers a curated selection of settings, metal types, and diamond options — including various shapes, qualities, and carat weights — so you can tailor your piece to your style and budget.

settings.title: Can I see my design before I purchase it?
settings.content: Yes. You’ll be able to view your piece in an interactive 3D experience that updates in real time as you make selections. This allows you to explore every angle and detail before placing your order.

settings.title: How long does it take to receive my jewelry after I design it?
settings.content: Most Design Studio pieces are handcrafted to order and ship within 3–4 weeks. Once your piece ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with tracking included.

settings.title: What is the return or exchange policy for Design Studio pieces?
settings.content: Items created through the Design Studio follow the same return policy as all MiaDonna jewelry: you may return or exchange your piece within 60 days from the date it ships. For more information, visit our Returns Page.

settings.title: Can I save my design and come back later?
settings.content: Yes. You can save your design to your account and revisit it anytime — perfect for comparing options or sharing with someone special.

settings.title: Can I work with a jewelry expert during the design process?
settings.content: Absolutely. If you’d like personalized guidance, feel free to contact us and we’ll be happy to help.

settings.title: What if I want something even more custom than what the Studio offers?
settings.content: We can help bring truly one-of-a-kind ideas to life. If you’re envisioning something beyond the available options, contact us and our custom design team will assist you.

settings.title: Are the diamonds in my Design Studio piece lab grown?
settings.content: Yes. Every diamond we offer is lab grown — a real diamond with the same chemical, physical, and optical properties as a mined diamond. Lab grown diamonds are also an ethically sourced and more attainable luxury option, helping you create the piece you want while staying within your budget.

settings.title: Will my Design Studio piece come with a warranty?
settings.content: Yes. All MiaDonna jewelry includes our Lifetime Manufacturing Warranty.
